findings.note: Listed as a coauthor of HB 5337, which would require a person to submit proof of citizenship to register to vote and creates criminal offenses. The date is the committee-report date shown on the bill page; the page does not give the date he was added. The bill had been reported out of committee and sent to Calendars.

Listed among the House cosponsors of SB 16, which would require proof of citizenship to register to vote, with a limited federal ballot for voters who cannot supply the proof. The date is the House committee-report date on the bill page; the page does not give the date he was added.

Listed as a coauthor of HB 2773, relating to the unlawful altering of election procedures with a civil penalty. The bill was left pending in committee on 2025-04-09. The date is when the bill was read the first time.
